_comment: The whole safety model for pod names. A student cannot type a name and cannot
choose one, so nothing protects them except these two lists. Every one of the
4096 pairs has to be safe on its own — no insult, no slur, no comment about a
body, nothing sexual — because the bridge will hand out pairs nobody read first.
Rules used to curate, so an edit does not quietly undo them:
- No adjectives about size, weight, shape, skin, colour or intelligence.
- No adjectives that are an insult in any English-speaking country ('windy',
'soft', 'balmy', 'dim' all read as jokes about a person somewhere).
- No animals that are slang for a body part, a person, or an act (eel, clam,
crab, shrimp, beaver, booby, whale, trout, urchin all cut for that reason).
- No word that is a homophone of a slur (pollock was cut for that alone).
- Nothing that echoes a league tier, so 'Quiet Reef' cannot be read as a rank.
Add a word only after checking it against every word in the other list.
